regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual source title and aggregate copper/photoredox 1,4-amidocyanation claim. The abstract is a method summary, not an experiment-specific run.

Background allene synthesis and cited enyne 1,4-difunctionalization classes are literature context. The specific cited diene example and current generic scheme are classified on page 2 rather than turning every reference into a current-paper experiment.

unresolved: The page contains no current-paper row-specific quantities, yields, or procedures beyond the abstract-level claim.

regions.finding: Classified the cited Zhu-group enantioselective diene 1,2-amidocyanation as a literature example with its displayed catalyst system, degassed CHCl3/N2/blue-light conditions, 34–73% yield range, and about-14% typical racemic result.
Classified the displayed 1,3-enyne/N-sulfonamidopyridinium/TMSCN 1,4-amidocyanation as a general current scheme. Experiment-specific rows appear in Table 1 and Scheme 2.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, ligand drawings, entries 1–22, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Recorded all 22 optimization rows independently with the shared 1a/2a/TMSCN/catalyst/ligand/DCM/Ar/blue-light/room-temperature/12 h conditions and row-specific omissions, replacements, solvent/light/temperature variations, scale-up, or salt change. Source-grouped 'or' alternatives remain grouped because no alternative-specific outcomes are assigned.

regions.region: page 2 lower optimization prose and Scheme 2 introduction
regions.finding: Mapped the prose to Table 1 rows and Scheme 2 entries without duplicates. Retained conflicts where Table 1 says trace but prose says no activity/no detectable product, and retained entry 21's explicit 1 mmol 1a scale without inventing other scaled charges.

unresolved: Grouped optimization rows do not provide alternative-specific yields.
Table/prose trace-versus-no-activity conflicts remain unresolved for entries 4, 5, 12, and 13.
Entry 21 does not restate the absolute 2a/TMSCN charges or DCM volume.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 2 shared header and 42-product grid
regions.finding: Recorded 26 enyne-scope rows 3ba–3aaa and 16 salt-scope rows 3ab–3aq separately with shared caption conditions, product-specific yields/trace outcomes, 3ra 2:1 dr, and CCDC 2288822 characterization of 3ya. The standard 3aa run remains Table 1 entry 1 and was not duplicated.
Recorded separate MeOH and H2O competition conditions (3 equiv each): 3aa 59%/54% and oxygenated products 4/5 trace. Unprinted standard-component charges were not inferred.
Recorded four separate 3-equiv additive controls: TEMPO trace 3aa, BHT 22% 3aa, BQ trace 3aa, and 1,1-diphenylethylene giving trace 3aa plus trapping product 6 in 62%.
Recorded TMSSCN and TMSN3 as two separate alternative-nucleophile runs, each producing the displayed product 7 or 8 only in trace amount. The source does not print TMSX amount.

Retained the main-text qualitative Stern–Volmer quenching observation and light on–off conclusion as partial/unresolved mechanistic measurements. Numerical plots and SI-only conditions were not imported because SI association is unestablished.

unresolved: Scheme 2/3 do not state ordinary yield bases, workups, purifications, or product masses.
Trace/inert and trace/not-amenable wording differences are retained for failed scope rows.
Stern–Volmer and light on–off numerical details are only in unassociated SI.
